title: Design: Over limit badge looks as it does today
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • {Customer-A} is on Net 30 with a credit limit of {Amount-A} and a balance above it.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-36 Over, {Amount-A} is $500.00.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} is open for {Customer-A}.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-17322.
  • Starting screen: the Work Orders page.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design picture ct-p9-01-an-invoice-today-net-30.png is attached to this case; open it at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open work order {Work-order-1}.
  2. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: under the work order number a red "Over Limit" pill shows beside the status badge, the same as today's picture ct-p9-01-an-invoice-today-net-30.png.
  • Step 2: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

The PRD writes "Over limit"; today's badge reads "Over Limit" and the PRD keeps the existing badge (register CT-D07, settled).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11678 (Story 9, Over Credit warning)

  • S9-R2: “The "Over limit" badge on work orders and part sales follows the same rule as S9-R1.”
  • Story 9, Form factor: “Form factor: Mobile-optimized: no new screen; the existing confirmation and "Over limit" badge keep their existing mobile variants and only change when they appear.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "9 Invoice due date" ("An invoice today (Net 30)"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes, except where this held design case follows the design.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p9-01-an-invoice-today-net-30.png

The design's own words:

  • “Part sales show no over-credit confirmation (S9-R4); for part sales only the "Over limit" badge follows this rule.”
